name: Hero
purpose: A large, responsive marketing banner at the top of a page, carrying a primary message (headline + intro + CTA) over an image or video, with an optional secondary message. Fully responsive across breakpoints with fixed- or full-height variants.

props.name: breakpoint
props.$note: Responsive hero artboards: XL (scale-3), M & L (scale-2), MS (scale-1), S & XS (scale-1).

primary-message.note: Also a '.Primary message with a corner' variant (hexagon corner).

tokens.arrow-link: color/primary + em-scaled flex-centred chevron (.85em, gap:4px) — legacy icon/arrow + padding/arrow retired 2026-07-17
tokens.glass-background: transparent surface (color/grey/transparent/white-75 or black-85) + background blur (radius blur/background-surface = 12)
tokens.$finding: (2026-06-20) BASELINE: text-on-surface only. The on-IMAGE variant (text/reverse over a photo + a guaranteed-contrast scrim) is FLAGGED — needs an image asset + scrim, a design decision.

commonPatterns: image/video hero with glass message panel

accessibility.heading: REVIEW (inferred): hero headline is typically the page h1; ensure correct heading level
accessibility.textOverMedia: Text over image/video must meet contrast — the solid/transparent message panel (with blur) exists to guarantee legible contrast over busy media; don't place text directly on uncontrolled imagery
accessibility.video: REVIEW (inferred): background video must be pausable and must not autoplay audio; respect prefers-reduced-motion

antiPatterns: Placing message text directly over uncontrolled imagery without the solid/transparent (blurred) panel that guarantees contrast
REVIEW (inferred): autoplaying background video with sound / no pause control
Leaving message backgrounds bound to deprecated surface/transparent tokens — rebind to the live primitives/blur (see tokenValidation)

tokenValidation.against: token store re-based on Figma native variable export
tokenValidation.result: PASS (values resolve) — several deprecated surface/border + a legacy-namespace token; clean rebinds available
tokenValidation.newTokenGroupSeen: blur/* (background blur for glass/transparent message panels) — live; first component to use it.

depricateUsage.legacyNamespace: 'Non-interactive/Content/On Light/colour-content-primary' (#333333) — an OLDER token namespace (not the 'depricate' suffix). Rebind to text/default. Flag: a second legacy naming scheme exists beyond the depricate set.
